claim_text: Best-value supply chains pursue integrated cost, quality, speed, and flexibility priorities and use SCM strategically for competitive advantage.
claim_location: Abstract; Best value and traditional supply chains
notes: Objective coded Flexibility as primary; other explicit priorities retained in claim text.

claim_text: Most examined uncertainty dimensions negatively affect supply-chain resilience; the study tests information sharing as a moderator.
notes: SEM on 244 internationally operating manufacturing firms in Turkey.

claim_text: Effective information sharing significantly enhances supply-chain practice, and both are critical to supply-chain performance.
notes: Survey data from 125 North American manufacturing firms.

claim_text: Contractual and relational governance positively affect supply-chain resilience, with collaboration partially mediating and institutional environment moderating these effects.
notes: Questionnaire data from 358 Chinese manufacturing companies.

claim_text: Perceived usefulness, attitude, and perceived behavioural control affect behavioural intention to adopt blockchain in supply chains.
notes: SEM survey of 181 practitioners; theories explicitly declared.

claim_text: Supply-related pharmaceutical risks should be prioritized over operational, financial, and demand-related risks in the studied setting.
notes: Delphi plus AHP; experts from five pharmaceutical companies.

claim_text: Public announcements of supply-chain glitches involving production or shipment delays are associated with a 10.28% abnormal decrease in shareholder value.
notes: Event study of 519 glitch announcements, 1989-2000.

claim_text: Intertwined supply-network viability extends resilience analysis toward survivability at a system-wide scale and defines a novel decision-making environment.
notes: Position paper; dynamic game-theoretic illustration does not by itself elevate evidence maturity beyond conceptual.

claim_text: Under increasing turbulence, supply chains require structural flexibility and flexible design options rather than models premised mainly on stability and control.
notes: Supply Chain Volatility Index plus case-study evidence.

claim_text: Global companies emphasize different social, environmental, and economic responsibility themes upstream and downstream according to industry, size, and geography.
notes: Content analysis of CSR reports from 100 companies.

claim_text: A system-dynamics representation of global PPE supply chains can identify leverage points and mitigation strategies for pandemic disruptions.
notes: Conceptual SD model informed by literature and empirical interviews; maturity coded Simulation for the evaluated model.

claim_text: RFID use in supply-chain management may create and sustain competitive advantage through organizational learning and first-mover mechanisms.
notes: Theory-building paper with four propositions.

claim_text: Sixteen barriers to circular supply-chain adoption in India exhibit structured interdependencies that can be analyzed with ISM-MICMAC to support implementation priorities.
notes: Literature plus expert feedback; ISM-MICMAC analysis.

claim_text: Integrated supply-chain management aligns sourcing decisions with manufacturing goals to improve responsiveness to customer needs.
notes: SEM on 215 North American manufacturing firms.

claim_text: Supply-chain risk management addresses risks arising from interconnected material, information, and financial flows and seeks resilient supply chains through risk-management practices.
notes: Open repository chapter; primary flow coded Risk while claim retains the explicit interconnected flows.

claim_text: Building resilience to system-wide disruptions requires coordinated evolution in forecasting, supply-chain risk management, and product design.
source_support: Publisher full text / institutional accepted manuscript
notes: Viewpoint supported by narrative literature review; no empirical maturity inferred.

claim_text: Supply-chain resilience contributes to sustainable competitive advantage through a dynamic-capability perspective.
notes: Theory explicitly declared in source title/model; real survey evidence.

claim_text: A blockchain- and IoT-based framework can increase information transparency in supply-chain finance while supporting capital-flow and logistics coordination.
notes: Method label requires adjudication against frozen method vocabulary; technology is explicit. Evidence maturity conservatively coded Synthetic pending detailed evaluation-section audit. Pre-reliability source-note adjudication: framework proposal; method/evidence maturity set to Conceptual.

claim_text: Construction SCM has four distinct roles, and observed waste and problems often originate at different supply-chain stages from where they are detected.
notes: Case studies plus comparison with prior research.

claim_text: Supply Chain 4.0 technologies can support more responsive and resilient supply chains after major disruptions such as COVID-19.
notes: Conceptual paper; technology sophistication not treated as empirical maturity.

claim_text: AHP-DEMATEL can identify critical COVID-19 supply-chain disruption factors and evaluate risk-reduction strategies for resilience.
notes: Multi-criteria decision analysis; no theory inferred.

claim_text: SCM can be represented through reliable and valid constructs derived from strategic collaboration and interdependent supply-network relationships.
notes: Instrument-development study synthesized >400 articles and conducted measurement analysis/refinement.

claim_text: An integrated supply-chain framework can jointly organize resilience and sustainability objectives, capabilities, stakeholders, risks, and performance measurement.
notes: Conceptual framework grounded in structured literature analysis; no empirical test inferred.

claim_text: Practitioner evidence structures integrated supply-chain risk management around philosophy, principles, and processes while indicating expected increases in supply-chain vulnerability.
notes: Exploratory survey and focus groups with supply-chain managers.

claim_text: Supply-chain risk-management requirements derived from practitioner evidence emphasize integrated management rather than isolated firm-level risk treatment.
notes: Second distinct substantive claim from same study; retained same study_id to prevent publication-level double counting.

claim_text: The strategic value of RFID depends on mechanisms linking technology use to organizational learning and first-mover advantages rather than on technology adoption alone.
notes: Distinct mechanism claim from same study as C0012.

claim_text: Resilience is treated as an organizational capability whose relationship with sustainable competitive advantage is empirically tested rather than inferred from technology adoption.
notes: Second distinct source-supported claim; same study_id retained.

claim_text: Sharing demand and inventory information in a one-supplier multi-retailer inventory model lowers supply-chain costs relative to a traditional order-only information policy.
notes: Abstract reports average cost reduction of 2.2% and maximum difference of 12.1% in the numerical study.

claim_text: Among identified barriers to green supply-chain implementation in the studied Indian auto-component firms, the supplier barrier is the dominant barrier for maintaining environmental awareness.
notes: ISM analysis; applied to ten auto-component manufacturing industries in Tamil Nadu.

claim_text: Supply-chain and technological barriers are the most critical blockchain-adoption barriers for sustainable supply chains according to academic and industry-expert assessments.
notes: DEMATEL analysis with academic and practitioner inputs; theory explicitly stated.

claim_text: Institutional pressures drive manufacturers' internal green supply-chain practices, which in turn relate to external GSCM adoption; economic performance effects are indirect rather than direct.
notes: Path analysis of 396 Chinese manufacturers.

claim_text: Sustainable supply-chain practice in recognized UK private-sector leaders is shaped by organizational and contextual factors and exhibits a gap between sustainability rhetoric and implementation.
notes: Seven-company case study using semi-structured interviews and secondary data.

claim_text: Chinese manufacturers' green supply-chain management is empirically characterized through drivers, practices and performance, with survey evidence used to test propositions about environmental supply-chain management.
notes: Survey research; abstract supports empirical study design but detailed proposition outcomes require fuller source inspection.

claim_text: Lean supply is evaluated against supply-chain management, partnership sourcing and strategic purchasing to identify how supplier-management techniques support lean production.
notes: Observations based principally on automotive/electronics research across UK, Italy, Scandinavia, USA and Japan.

claim_text: Buyer socialization and supply-chain integration improve supplier communication and operational performance and support supplier contractual conformance.
notes: Model explicitly embeds activities in socialization and supply-chain integration.

claim_text: Short food supply chains should be understood as dynamically built and reproduced structures whose temporal, spatial, demand and institutional evolution affects their rural-development role.
notes: Theoretical perspective with case-study illustration of Llyn Beef Producers Co-operative.

claim_text: Disaster supply chains in Bangladesh are impaired by demand-estimation, coordination, interoperability, infrastructure and information-sharing failures, motivating a redesigned emergency supply-chain infrastructure.
source_support: Authoritative abstract plus institutional manuscript record
notes: Representative cases and interviews with more than 500 stakeholders.

claim_text: Internal integration, external integration with key suppliers and customers, and external flexibility positively affect firm supply-chain agility for disruption-risk mitigation and response.
notes: PLS structural-equation modeling; agility treated as risk-management capability.

claim_text: AI adoption in Vietnamese manufacturing SMEs positively influences circular-economy practices, supply-chain agility and risk management, which contribute to supply-chain resilience.
notes: SEM on 280 operations managers; theoretical perspectives explicitly stated.

claim_text: Big-data analytics capabilities improve supply-chain performance through the mediating roles of supply-chain resilience and supply-chain innovation.
notes: Cross-sectional survey of 187 responses analyzed with PLS.

claim_text: Relatively low levels of operational flexibility can provide significant strategic value for mitigating supply-chain risks across stylized risk models.
notes: Unified framework with five stylized models.

claim_text: Supply-chain metrics should connect customer- and supplier-relationship processes across firms to profitability and shareholder value rather than measure only internal logistics performance.
notes: Framework translates process improvements into supplier/customer profitability and aligns objectives across firms.

claim_text: Toyota's recovery from the Tohoku semiconductor disruption illustrates how supply-chain coordination mechanisms and disruption-management actions shape recovery time.
notes: Case of Renesas microcontrollers supplied to Toyota; three-month recovery described.

claim_text: Internet use in business-to-business supply chains can accelerate customer-supplier communication, improve service and reduce logistics costs across major supply-chain processes.
notes: Study describes Internet application across transportation, purchasing, inventory, customer service, production scheduling, warehousing and vendor relations.

claim_text: Environmentally sound supply-chain management links purchasing practices such as vendor assessment, quality management, lean supply and collaboration with environmental imperatives.
notes: Field research with five UK companies supplements conceptual analysis.

claim_text: Supply-chain performance measurement should connect metrics to strategic, tactical and operational planning, objective setting, performance evaluation and future action.
notes: Framework paper retained as primary conceptual evidence pending no contrary role decision.

claim_text: Artificial intelligence applications in operations and supply-chain management are examined through an exploratory organizational case to identify operational uses and management implications.
notes: Exploratory case-study framing explicit; detailed findings require full source for narrower claims.

claim_text: Coordinating internal and external green supply-chain practices produces mediation effects on environmental, economic and operational performance in Chinese manufacturing enterprises.
notes: Survey of 396 Chinese manufacturing enterprises; theory explicitly stated.

claim_text: Increasing global sourcing, supply-chain complexity and lean operations heighten vulnerability, motivating deliberate creation of more resilient supply chains to manage disruption risk.
notes: Foundational resilience argument; no empirical maturity inferred from topic prominence.

claim_text: In a two-level supply chain, sharing demand information can reduce inventory-related costs by improving upstream demand knowledge relative to order-only information.
notes: Analytical information-sharing study; source evidence supports decision and cost consequence.

claim_text: Strategic supplier relationships can contribute to competitive advantage through interorganizational learning and knowledge-development mechanisms.
notes: Empirical strategic supplier-relationship study; focal mechanism is knowledge development.

claim_text: Supply-chain disruption risk can be managed through mitigation actions taken before disruption and contingency actions taken after disruption, with their relative value depending on disruption characteristics.
notes: Analytical comparison of mitigation and contingency strategies.

claim_text: Supply-chain management practice can be represented and empirically validated through multiple practice dimensions whose implementation relates to competitive advantage and organizational performance.
notes: Scale-development/validation study of SCM practices.

claim_text: The value and incentives for information sharing in a supply chain depend on competitive interactions and the information structure facing participating firms.
notes: Analytical study of information sharing under competition.

claim_text: Supply-chain visibility is shaped by information sharing and connectivity across firms and can influence operational performance through improved access to relevant supply-chain information.
notes: Empirical/theory-based visibility study; technology kept generic because no single enabling technology is established.

claim_text: Strategic purchasing can contribute to firm performance when the purchasing function is integrated with broader competitive and supply-management priorities.
notes: Focal claim limited to relationship supported by abstract metadata.

claim_text: Supply-management capabilities and supplier integration can be treated as organizational resources whose configuration contributes to operational and competitive performance.
notes: Theory recorded only where explicitly identified in bibliographic evidence.

claim_text: Collaborative planning and supply-chain coordination can reduce mismatch between supply and demand and improve replenishment performance in an implemented business setting.
notes: Evidence maturity marked Deployed only if implementation described in source is confirmed during final adjudication; otherwise downgrade to Case study. Conservative pre-reliability adjudication: implementation evidence not sufficiently verified for Deployed; downgraded to Case study.
